# Epsilon Audio

> Epsilon Audio is a free, open-source series of fifteen audio plugins (3 instruments and 12 effects) from Epsilon Records, Amsterdam. They come in VST3, AU and CLAP formats for macOS (universal), Windows (x64) and Linux (x64), with VST2 on Windows and Linux. Every plugin is free, MIT-licensed and ships with factory presets and a manual.

## Pages

- [Epsilon Audio](https://plugins.epsilonrecords.com/): the full catalogue, download links and what each plugin does
- [Install guides](https://plugins.epsilonrecords.com/install): where the plugin files go on macOS, Windows and Linux, and troubleshooting
- [How they're made](https://plugins.epsilonrecords.com/made): clean-room designs written from scratch, open source under the MIT licence

## Plugins

Each plugin has its own page, with its formats, version and download link, and its own source repository.

- [Monolith](https://plugins.epsilonrecords.com/monolith): Subtractive synthesizer, mono or 10-voice poly.
- [Caldera](https://plugins.epsilonrecords.com/caldera): Stereo filter effect with up to four filters, eleven styles and drag-and-drop modulation.
- [Obsidian](https://plugins.epsilonrecords.com/obsidian): Polyphonic four-oscillator, four-filter synthesizer with effects and an arpeggiator, up to 64 voices.
- [Strata](https://plugins.epsilonrecords.com/strata): Stereo tape delay with extra taps, filters in the feedback loop, lo-fi, ducking and pitch effects, and freeze.
- [Basalt](https://plugins.epsilonrecords.com/basalt): Stereo dual filter for live use.
- [Gneiss](https://plugins.epsilonrecords.com/gneiss): Stereo compressor with 14 styles, lookahead, oversampling, a sidechain EQ and loudness metering.
- [Mica](https://plugins.epsilonrecords.com/mica): 24-band stereo equalizer with dynamic and spectral EQ, EQ Match and three phase modes.
- [Flint](https://plugins.epsilonrecords.com/flint): Small saturating filter with an envelope follower.
- [Granite](https://plugins.epsilonrecords.com/granite): Stereo look-ahead brickwall limiter with true-peak limiting, oversampling, dither and loudness metering.
- [Slate](https://plugins.epsilonrecords.com/slate): Gate, expander and ducker with six styles, sidechain filters and MIDI triggering.
- [Magma](https://plugins.epsilonrecords.com/magma): Multiband distortion with 28 styles, linear-phase crossovers and drag-and-drop modulation.
- [Talc](https://plugins.epsilonrecords.com/talc): De-esser with single-vocal detection and linear-phase split-band processing.
- [Schist](https://plugins.epsilonrecords.com/schist): Multiband compressor and expander with freely placed bands and Inf:1 limiting and gating.
- [Geode](https://plugins.epsilonrecords.com/geode): Algorithmic reverb with three algorithms, a decay rate EQ, a post EQ and impulse response import.
- [Malachite](https://plugins.epsilonrecords.com/malachite): Acid bass synthesizer with a sub oscillator, accent, slide and a 16-step pattern sequencer with 64 patterns and scales.

## Source

- [epsilon-plugins on GitHub](https://github.com/epsilon-records/epsilon-plugins): the plugin index and machine-readable catalogue (plugins.json)
- [Epsilon Records](https://epsilonrecords.com): the label behind Epsilon Audio
